evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Reflective memory stores procedural guidance distilled from task trajectories.
During operation, RRM applies LLM-mediated memory editing to entity-centric factual video graph; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, RRM applies abstraction of episodes into reusable experience to entity-centric factual video graph; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
Reuse feedback and outcomes change guidance for later searches. The persistent later-use effect is deployment-feedback evolution of the reusable retrieval policy or procedure.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF pp. 4–5): Test-time mini-batch feedback stores reflective retrieval procedures derived from success/failure and reuses them on later batches, satisfying strict T3. The qualifying feedback occurs during deployment/inference and affects later use.
